garroth.name: Garroth Bloodfields
garroth.desc: Torch-bearers set wooden structures on fire. Build in wood for speed or stone to stand.
garroth.rule: Torches burn wood. Stone does not catch.
garroth.tip: Wood is cheap but burns fast. Stone is costly but holds all battle. Mix them.
garroth.intro: This field once held grain. Now it holds only smoke and the sound of drums.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.desc: Close range and staying power. Stronger in the thick of the horde.

arcanist.name: Arcanist
arcanist.desc: Wide spells and fire. Faster casting, hotter flames.

commander.name: Commander
commander.desc: Towers, traps and AI heroes do the fighting.

vg-second-wind.name: Second Wind
vg-second-wind.desc: +0.3 HP regeneration per second per rank.

vg-hardened-hide.name: Hardened Hide
vg-hardened-hide.desc: Tough Hide card: +0.3 regeneration and +2% armour per rank.

vg-juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
vg-juggernaut.desc: Keystone. +50% max HP and +10% armour, but 20% slower.

ar-kindling.name: Kindling
ar-kindling.desc: Pitch Arrows card: +5% bonus damage to burning enemies per rank.

ar-ember-mastery.name: Ember Mastery
ar-ember-mastery.desc: Ember Ring card: +10 radius and +2 damage per rank.

hu-steady-split.name: Steady Split
hu-steady-split.desc: Split Shot card: its damage penalty is 5 points smaller per rank.

hu-lone-wolf.name: Lone Wolf
hu-lone-wolf.desc: Keystone. No AI heroes join your runs, but +40% damage and max HP, +15% speed, +10% critical chance.

cm-masonry.name: Masonry
cm-masonry.desc: +4% tower and trap damage per rank.

cm-front-line.name: Front Line
cm-front-line.desc: Iron Vanguard card: its tower penalty is 10 points smaller per rank.

cm-fortress-lord.name: Fortress Lord
cm-fortress-lord.desc: Keystone. Towers and AI heroes deal double damage, but your hero deals only a quarter.

hy-spellblade.name: Spellblade
hy-spellblade.desc: Vanguard + Arcanist. +10% damage and max HP; Ember Ring +3 damage.

hy-bloodhunter.name: Blood Hunter
hy-bloodhunter.desc: Vanguard + Hunter. +3% critical chance; Blood Price heals 2 points more.

hy-warden.name: Warden
hy-warden.desc: Hunter + Commander. +8% weapon range and +10% tower damage.

raider.name: Raider
raider.desc: The tribe's baseline horde. Walks straight for the Core.

torch-bearer.name: Torch-bearer
torch-bearer.desc: Hunts your structures and sets wood on fire.

brute.name: Ironhide Brute
brute.desc: A hulk in scavenged iron plate. Slow, but hits hard.
brute.counter: resists physical; use fire or focus

slinger.name: Slinger
slinger.desc: Stays far back and hurls stones at your structures. Outranges archer towers.

wolf-rider.name: Wolf Rider
wolf-rider.desc: The fastest thing on the field. Ignores everything but the Core.

war-drummer.name: War Drummer
war-drummer.desc: Its drumbeat makes nearby enemies hit harder and move faster.

shield-chieftain.name: Brannok, Shieldwall Chieftain
shield-chieftain.desc: Raises a shield that turns aside ordinary weapons, then lowers it for a moment.

beast-master.name: Kharsa the Houndcaller
beast-master.desc: Howls to call wolf packs that dive for the Core.
beast-master.counter: stop the howl before the pack

fire-priest.name: Ashmoth the Pyre-Priest
fire-priest.desc: Sets the whole base alight at once. Wood burns, stone survives.

varkul.name: Varkul, the Unbeaten
varkul.desc: The warlord who gathered Garroth under one banner. Fights in three forms.

shield-chieftain.name: Brannok, Shieldwall Chieftain
shield-chieftain.intro: My shield has never broken. Only men who tire of striking it.
shield-chieftain.defeat: The shield grows heavier…as if someone wrote me to carry it.

beast-master.name: Kharsa the Houndcaller
beast-master.intro: Hear them? My pack. They are hungrier than I am.
beast-master.phase2: Come, my children. All of you!
beast-master.defeat: Pack…I only barked the lines I was given.

fire-priest.name: Ashmoth the Pyre-Priest
fire-priest.intro: Every beam is kindling. Every wall of yours, an altar.
fire-priest.phase2: Burn! Let the whole field see!
fire-priest.defeat: The fire is out…but the ink on my hands is not yet dry.

varkul.name: Varkul, the Unbeaten
varkul.intro: I have never lost, small trespasser. Be the last page I fill.
varkul.phase2: One banner. One drum. One pack. Watch where my iron points.
varkul.phase3: If this field must burn, let it burn with my name on it!
varkul.defeat: I was never beaten…because whoever wrote this line never let me be.

piercing-bolt.name: Piercing Bolt
piercing-bolt.desc: Arrows pierce 1 more enemy per level and fly 10% faster.

magnet-charm.name: Magnet Charm
magnet-charm.desc: Pickup radius +40% per level and a little extra XP.

tough-hide.name: Tough Hide
tough-hide.desc: Max HP +15% per level, regenerate HP, and gain armor at higher levels.

split-shot.name: Split Shot
split-shot.desc: Fire one more arrow per level.

blood-price.name: Blood Price
blood-price.desc: Heal for part of the damage you deal.

pitch-arrows.name: Pitch Arrows
pitch-arrows.desc: Arrows set enemies on fire. Burning enemies take +25% extra from your hits.

ember-ring.name: Ember Ring
ember-ring.desc: A ring of fire pulses around you, hurting and igniting nearby enemies.

archer-tower-wood.name: Archer tower
archer-tower-wood.desc: Shoots the nearest enemy in range. Burns. Upkeep 2 wood.

fire-pit-trap.name: Fire pit
fire-pit-trap.desc: Burns and ignites enemies standing in it. Also ignites wooden walls on its 4 sides.

mira.name: Mira
mira.desc: A careful archer who never leaves her post.

brann.name: Brann
brann.desc: A hot-headed brawler who charges any enemy he sees, far beyond the base.

menu.epigraph: Some worlds were written to fall.

build.title: Build
build.upkeepShort: Not enough for upkeep: structures will decay
build.tapSlot: Tap a free slot on the ground.

confirm.title: Leave this run?
confirm.body: Progress in this run is lost.

results.quote: It was written that I fall here.
results.quoteDefeat: It was written that you fall here.
